verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents scoped API keys that grant only the Read or Write permissions you assign on specific APIs, instead of full account access, which is the least-privilege credential the story asks for. Its agent-facing surfaces add their own guardrails: AgentOS MCP authenticates via OAuth and blocks money-out actions by default, and CLI OAuth is limited to Owner/Admin/Finance Admin roles. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detail on whether the OAuth grants for the MCP server and CLI can be narrowed per agent, and documentation of credential expiry and revocation.
